title: pallenis cuspidata subsp. canescens
intro: Pallenis cuspidata subsp. canescens, commonly known as the Greek chamomile or wild chamomile, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Pallenis cuspidata subsp. canescens include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in treating anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as chamazulene and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
